events.description: Sinha becomes Director of Geriatrics at Sinai Health System and UHN
events.quote: Since 2010 I have served as the Director of Geriatrics at Sinai Health System

events.description: CIHI issues its Definitions and Guidelines to Support ALC Designation in Acute Inpatient Care
Concerned Friends is incorporated as a registered charity
events.quote: In 1982 they were incorporated as a registered charity in Ontario

events.description: Ontario stops requiring an annual Resident Quality Inspection of every LTC home
events.quote:
in 2018, the Ontario 
government stopped requiring that every LTC home had an Resident Quality Inspections (RQI) 
annually

events.description: Only seven RQIs are conducted across 626 Ontario LTC homes in 2019, and none in 2020
events.quote:
with only seven RQIs 
across all 626 Ontario LTC homes in 2019, and zero in 2020

events.description: Government regulations allow hospital patients waiting for LTC to be put on the crisis placement list
events.quote: in March 2020 the Government proclaimed regulations mandating that hospital patients waiting for LTC homes could also be put on the crisis list

events.description: The High Intensity Support Services home care program is suspended when its funding runs out
events.quote: it too was suspended on March 31, 2022 when its funding ran out

events.description: Deputy Minister and Ontario Health issue Bill 7 implementation field guidance to health system partners
Daily $400 charge for ALC patients refusing an LTC placement is in effect
LTC Minister is quoted in the Toronto Star saying 2,400 patients had been moved from hospitals into LTC since Bill 7
January 2023 provincial ALC summary: 682 ALC-LTC patients in acute beds and 730 in post-acute beds
events.quote: According to the provincial ALC summaries for January 2023, there were 682 ALC-LTC patients in acute care beds

events.description: 3,425 ALC patients wait in acute care beds, 65% aged 75 or older
events.quote: waiting in acute care beds as of Jan 31, 2023, 65% were 75 years of age or older
